page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i family. It is equipped with 8 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, featuring 4 physical cores and hyper-threading. The instance includes 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For hardware acceleration, it features a single NVIDIA Pascal-generation P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and network performance is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

In terms of performance, the instance exhibits entry-level capabilities. Benchmark results indicate weak to poor CPU and memory performance compared to modern cloud hardware. The stress-ng single-core performance falls into the bottom 10%, while multi-core performance and memory bandwidth benchmarks consistently rank in the bottom 25%. Passmark CPU testing places the processor in the middle 50% overall, but specific subtests like encryption, physics, and extended instructions fall into the bottom 25%. Database operations and Redis SET throughput also reflect these performance constraints, registering in the bottom 25%.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge offers a budget-friendly entry point for workloads requiring dedicated GPU acceleration without the high cost of modern architecture. The older Intel Xeon Broadwell CPU and NVIDIA Pascal GPU architecture trade raw computational speed for lower resource costs. This makes the instance suitable for lightweight GPU workloads, legacy CUDA applications, basic video transcoding, and small-scale inference tasks where high-end performance is not required.
